Operation: assess-food-evidence(target, specimen, mode, evidenceRefs, methodRef?, equipmentRefs?, quantity?). General to accessible food specimens, with modes assess and execute-validated-method sharing one evidence pipeline. Initial executable mode is assess; execution is enabled only for an actually implemented, validated non-ingestive protocol whose contract supplies its prerequisites, costs, detection limits, controls, hazards and disposal rules. No tasting, ingestion, uncontrolled skin exposure or invented universal edibility test. Do not implement an empty success-producing trial mode.
Prerequisites and exact scope: identify an accessible target and unit, and references actually accessible to the actor. Lin's initial target may be commons-root-0-0, unit 1, in place. The prior traits reference commons-root-0-0:unit-1:traits is a four-part paged record; the supplied fragment is incomplete and must not be parsed as a complete record or treated as evidence for omitted properties. commons-root-0-0:observed-state is explicitly unverified and concerns source condition, not food safety. berry knowledge concerns berries only, not roots. Neither owned berry stack is a reagent or control. Darkness precludes new visual identification; a visual requiring light must wait for actual light. Source labels, stock, coordinates and simulation internals cannot establish identity or toxicity. No hidden resource properties are read or disclosed.
Inputs and costs: study takes 2 individually completed rounds at 0.2 energy each. An assessment takes 1 active round and 0.2 energy, examining one specimen against a bounded supplied set of at most four complete evidence references and one candidate method. Validate accessibility and reference completeness before charging; malformed or inaccessible inputs are refused free. An accessible specimen with no valid evidence or method is a valid paid assessment yielding a limitation report. It consumes, moves and reserves zero food, tools, reagents or water. Additional reading uses consult at its existing 1-round, 0.2-energy contract; additional physical inspection uses examine-material at its existing learning and execution costs and prerequisites. These are separate actions, not free observations hidden inside assessment. Travel, obtaining light, gathering and communications are separate. Material and trial energy costs cannot be invented now: execution remains unavailable until an exact validated method defines numerical quantities, duration and risks before commitment.
Effects and products: create a personal assessment record and observable completion event referencing actor, target, unit, evidence IDs and versions, candidate protocol, conditions, time, applicability checks, provenance and limitations. Keep direct observations, validated findings, unverified claims and unknowns separate. Report toxicity, edibility and preparation requirements independently. Each finding names exactly the tested hazard or preparation claim, method scope, detection limit and uncertainty when supported; absence of a result is not a negative result. A negative assay for one hazard never proves general edibility. Preparation guidance requires an applicable validated reference; no recipe or detoxification efficacy is guessed. For Lin's currently supplied evidence the supported result is: no validated non-ingestive method established among supplied accessible evidence; toxicity, edibility and preparation requirements remain unknown. List concrete unmet prerequisites: applicable validated identification/reference or assay protocol, and its actually required equipment, controls, safe conditions and materials. Do not assert that such a method cannot exist. A later protocol proposal enters this same development handoff with its real mechanism, not a fixed-era unlock or invented activity roadmap.

For any future executable assay, debit only explicit real sample/reagent quantities, track remaining sample, products, residues and waste, conserve material through transfers and transformations, and report energy inputs and dissipation. Obtain required actor authorization through actual actions; never fabricate consent or another participant's contribution. Establish numeric per-step costs and outputs before enabling that method. Initial audit commits atomically at round completion: interrupted work spends only elapsed effort and produces no completed assessment; retry is a new paid assessment. Completed records persist; unfinished drafts are not findings. Cancel is free and grants no refund of spent time or energy. Death stops work without completion or refund; existing world items remain under ordinary death rules. No continuing process, reservation or maintenance is introduced by the audit. Findings remain historical and become inapplicable when specimen identity, condition or evidence dependencies change; no automatic revalidation. Future multi-step protocols require serialized progress, safe interruption/resume, explicit consumed versus unconsumed inputs, release of unused reservations on cancel/death, and no duplication or refund of consumed inputs.
